skipped.why: icm7224-icm7225-harris p.1 ordering table: 40-pin plastic DIP with the 'R' reversed-leads configuration; the sheet gives no reversed pinout, so no pinout can be written.
not in any ordering table: the Harris table (p.1) lists only ICM7224IPL, ICM7224IJL and ICL7224RIPL; Maxim lists ICM7225IPL and ICM7225IQH.

cd22105-harris.pdf has no ordering table; only the 'E' suffix 40-lead plastic DIP is stated (p.1 'supplied in the 40-lead dual-in-line plastic (E suffix) package', p.8 drawing). CD22105E and CD22105AE are the two names (the 'A' type is the decimal one, p.5 Table I).

engineNeeds.needs: A device whose display driver is `lcd` must also be able to drive plain output pins from register fields: the ICM7224's CARRY (pin 28) and LZB OUT (pin 30). Requested form: an optional `"ports"` array inside the `lcd` display object, same entries as the `ports` driver (`{"pin", "dataField", "invert"}`; no dirField): the pin drives 1 while the field is nonzero, else 0, strong, computed with every register change. The ICM7224 device already keeps the two fields up to date (`OUT.CARRY` = high from count 6000 to 9999 of each 10000 counts; `OUT.LZBOUT` = LZB IN high, half digit clear, count 0000, live decoder state not latched by STORE): the same two registers drive the pins of the ICM7225 today through its `ports` driver. Without the key the ICM7224's CARRY and LZB OUT pins are listed outputs that nothing drives (an 8-digit cascade of two ICM7224 cannot be built).

Internal input pull-ups: RESET, STORE, COUNT INHIBIT and LZB IN have 10 uA pull-ups to V+ (icm7224-icm7225-maxim p.2-3 'Input Pull-up Currents', p.5 pin descriptions: 'inactive when ... floating'), the datasheet's circuits leave them open. Requested key: a device list `"pullups": [pin names]` (bus pins and `levels` pins): a pin that reads Z is read as 1 (and a pin at X stays X). Today a floating pin among the five inputs of the counter reads X, so no event fires and the counter does nothing until every one of COUNT, RESET, COUNT INHIBIT, STORE and LZB IN is driven (the five pins must be wired high/low in a circuit: documented in the part's note).

Backplane slave mode of the LCD parts (ICM7224 OSC pin 36 grounded, icm7224-icm7225-maxim p.5 pin 5/36 and p.6-7; CD22105 pin 36 at Vss, cd22105-harris p.1): the BP pin becomes an input and the segments follow it. Requested `lcd` key `"slaveWhen": {"pin": "OSC", "level": 0}`: while the pin reads that level the driver releases BP (it reads the external backplane) and every segment pin carries (its RAM bit) XOR (the level read on BP), no frame timer. Today the model always drives BP, so two chips sharing a BP net drive the same wire from two outputs and run in the same phase only if their frame timers start together (they do, both start at time 0).

Not required, a simplification only: the counters are modeled today with the engine's existing features (the unlatched parallel bus with the five input pins listed as both `address` and `data` so one pin change is a ten-bit write that the `stream` frame matches as up to 6 chained commands; 99 commands). A `"pins": {"count": {"pin": "COUNT", "edge": "fall", "inhibit": "..."}}` counter action and a register-to-register copy in `set` would make the table about ten lines, but nothing in the model is missing without them.

notes: Four devices, seven parts, all loading with library_check and passing the bench (122 checks, ~1.5 s). newDevices (lcddriver.json): CD22105, CD22105A, ICM7224; newDevicesLeddriver (leddriver.json): ICM7225. Parts: CD22105E, CD22105AE (Renesas Electronics, no datasheet key: Renesas/Harris no longer host cd22105-harris.pdf, 404 on every renesas.com name tried), ICM7224IPL/IQH and ICM7225IPL/IQH (Analog Devices, datasheet icm7224-icm7225-maxim), ICM7224IJL (CERDIP, flags ceramic, Renesas Electronics, datasheet icm7224-icm7225-harris). Footprints exist: PDIP-40-600, PLCC-44, CDIP-40-600 (no new footprint). datasheets: icm7224-icm7225-maxim URL is NOT verified (analog.com did not answer from this machine, same as the other Maxim sheets; pattern of the verified ICM7211-ICM7212.pdf); icm7224-icm7225-harris URL https://www.renesas.com/en/document/dst/icm7224-datasheet answers a PDF (the Intersil ICM7224-only revision of May 2001, which carries an OBSOLETE PRODUCT / NO RECOMMENDED REPLACEMENT banner; it is a different document from the local Harris PDF but the same maker's ICM7224 sheet). obsolete flag: not set on any part (neither local sheet marks parts obsolete); the Renesas ICM7224 sheet and DigiKey (IQH+D) say obsolete: main thread decides. Distributor spellings: ICM7224IPL+ (Safari stock) and ICM7224IQH+D. Counter model: see the spec (section 3): count, reset, inhibit, store, LZB in/out, carry, half digit, 29 outputs; the display has registers SEG1..4/SEGH; the 5 input pins must all be driven.
